machine_boundary: Hydrated Settings registry and OPL card-based control-center input for active shell adapters. This contract owns ordinary and secondary page routing, compatibility redirects, slots, bilingual item search, page DOM/anchor requirements, visual behavior, and state/action source classification. It does not own OPL runtime truth, provider implementation, domain truth, release readiness, or shell-local rendering details.

opl app state --profile fast --json#app_state.agent_packages.directory + app_state.agent_packages.status_index + home_agent_shortcuts + app_state.operator.workbench.task_drilldowns
active shell local data lifecycle service + contracts/app-release-channel.json#local_data_lifecycle
